Date: 2026-03-01T15:10:00Z
Subject: MAP: Technical evaluation milestone - follow-up

Thanks again for the call earlier — that was really helpful.

As discussed, we're ready to move to a short technical evaluation to validate latency and cost targets for our chat and classification flows. Can you send a Mutual Action Plan draft that includes the technical evaluation milestone with clear success criteria, responsibilities, and a suggested target close date?

Quick background / constraints from our side:
- Expected workload: ~120 concurrent users, avg 1.2 requests/user/min during peak.
- Token profile: short prompts (30-80 tokens) and responses ~80-150 tokens.
- Hard latency requirement for UI: p95 < 200ms, prefer p99 < 350ms (we understand tradeoffs).
- Cost sensitivity: target inference spend < $X / 1k responses (we'll share actual budget once NDA redlines clear).

We want the MAP to include: milestone checklist, who on both sides owns infra/setup/data, test dataset, model shortlist, benchmark success criteria, and a target close date.

Thanks — can you get a draft by EOD tomorrow?

Best,
Jane Parker
Head of ML Systems
Acme Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Parker <jane.parker@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical evaluation milestone - draft attached

Jane — appreciate the clear constraints. Attached is an initial MAP draft (PDF) and the evaluation testset CSV we've put together from the sample prompts you shared. Highlights specific to the Technical Evaluation milestone below so it's easy to digest.

--- Technical Evaluation (milestone) — draft summary ---
Target close date: 2026-03-20 (3-week sprint)
Milestone owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole (AM) / Rishi Malhotra (SE)
Milestone owner (Acme): Jane Parker / Tom Li (engineering lead)
Success criteria (pass = all must be met):
- Latency: p95 < 150ms, p99 < 350ms (measured end-to-end from client to response on Acme staging)
- Throughput: sustain 120 concurrent simulated users with 95% request success rate
- Cost: incremental inference cost <= $0.45 per 1k responses (example target; will refine once we see real traffic mix)
- Quality: model output meets existing classification F1 baseline within +/-2 pts on your eval set
Model shortlist (to benchmark):
- Falcon-40B (optimized q4/kernels)
- Llama-2-13B (quantized)
- Mistral-Instruct-7B (fast edge variant)
- Redwood-verified small variant (redwood-v1-small) — if you want a low-cost baseline
Benchmark plan (high level):
- Run 3-run experiment per model variant: cold-start + warm cache + steady-state
- Measure: end-to-end latency distribution (p50/p95/p99), tokens/sec, GPU utilization, and cost per 1k responses
- Test data: use attached acme-eval-testset.csv (2000 examples across intents), plus live replay for load testing
Dependencies / blockers:
- Acme to provision staging endpoint & network access (VPN/VPC peering) — action: Tom Li
- NDA / security checklist items (we'll need SOC2 evidence for audit) — action: Jane (we'll loop Legal)
- Account quota for dedicated instances if scaling needed — action: Marissa to coordinate with infra

Next steps / timeline:
1) You confirm the model shortlist & success criteria (this email) — by 2026-03-03
2) Acme provides staging access + test account — by 2026-03-06
3) Redwood runs baselines and shares results — by 2026-03-13
4) Joint review, iterate, and close milestone — by 2026-03-20

I've attached the MAP PDF (includes these milestones in a table) and the CSV testset. Happy to adapt the criteria — Rishi, Dev, I left some flexibility on cost target pending your inputs.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0123
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jane Parker <jane.parker@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical evaluation milestone - technical notes

Adding technical detail from the SE side to make the benchmark reproducible.

Benchmark environment:
- Redwood Dedicated sandbox (us-west-2) accessible via temporary VPC peering; AMI + infra config will be provided in the Drive link.
- GPU profile: A100 / H100 family available; we'll start on A100 40GB for parity with cloud baseline.

Load profile & harness:
- Replay harness will simulate 120 concurrent users following your token distributions. We'll run 3x 30-minute windows: cold-start (no cache), warm (cache primed), and peak-surge (burst to 150 concurrency).
- Measurement tooling: OpenTelemetry traces for end-to-end p99, and internal token-level timing from the inference runtime.

Data & privacy:
- Use masked/hashed PII in the CSV (we did this already); any live replay will happen in Acme staging only.

Model config notes:
- For Llama-2-13B and Falcon-40B we'll test both fp16 and q4_0 quantized variants where supported to trade quality vs cost.
- We'll enable prefix caching for chat sessions to evaluate steady-state improvements.

Responsibility matrix (concise):
- Acme: provide staging access, replay credentials, and a primary engineering contact (Tom)
- Redwood: provide infra, run benchmarks, and share raw logs & cost estimates

Acceptance: We'll share a short report (CSV + Markdown) with: latency percentiles, token throughput, GPU utilization, and a cost model extrapolated to your projected monthly volume. If p95/p99 and cost targets are met, we mark the milestone complete.

I'll be hands-on for the runs; tagging Dev for infra setup.

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra
